tldr: Moon through the 7th house brings focus to partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others.
body: Moon transiting the 7th house stirs partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others. For about two to three days, emotion, instinct, and immediate need move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a fast emotional transit: it shows what needs care today, not necessarily what needs to define the whole season.
business: Moon supports relationship dynamics and agreements: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Mood-driven choices, insecurity, or handing your agency to someone else.
advice: Tend the feeling in the 7th house deliberately. Work with partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
